race.description: Vsta - Col & Dot Redwood Memorial 2yo Trot
race.comment: JILLIBY CONNECTION (7) started a hot favourite when making her debut at Listed level at Menangle but broke so did well to finish fifth. Has won a trial since. Has shown plenty of ability on the trial tracks, just needs to get it right on raceday. GULBAHAR (9) looks close to a win having placed in the last two outings, finishing third at Melton last time out. Danger. GATESYS DELIGHT (4) faces the starter for the first time. By Elite Stride and hails from the Hughes stable. Placed in a recent trial. Keep safe along with fellow debutant WATSON THE WIZARD (1) who placed in the latest trial and gets the inside draw.
